text:
ani: quick note — customer reported duplicated invoice in quickstart when 429 coincided with token refresh. attaching short repro.

cole: can you paste the repro steps?

ani: 1) call quickstart createInvoice until server returns 429. 2) auth refresh completes while backoff sleeping. 3) SDK retries immediately after refresh (no idempotency in quickstart) -> duplicate invoice created.

reza: JS quickstart omits idempotency to stay tiny. parity issue: py quickstart already shows it.

cole: two small fixes: (A) change quickstart to include a collapsed one-liner 'Idempotency-Key' example; (B) SDK tweak — detect auth refresh between attempts and mark retry as "refresh-triggered". Only auto-replay if idempotency present or user opts in.

ani: idea for SDK API: add `refreshReplayPolicy: 'allow' | 'require-idempotency' | 'error'` default 'allow' for DX but doc strict mode.

reza: also standardize backoff defaults across SDKs: base=100ms, cap=2000ms, factor=2, full-jitter. document interactive vs batch patterns.

bot: CI note — adding deterministic e2e that simulates 429 + token rotation. will fail if duplicate side-effects appear.

ani: action items: @cole update quickstart (tiny PR), @reza propose SDK flag + docs, @bot add CI e2e. target: next Wednesday.

cole: will open a small PR and keep snippet collapsed so quickstart stays minimal.

reza: I'll draft SDK CHANGELOG entry and include examples for JS/Py/Go.

ani: thanks all — small change, big UX win. :)
